definition: A standardized document accompanying a released model that describes its intended uses, limitations, training data, and evaluation results.
details: Model cards promote transparency by giving downstream users and developers the information needed to assess whether a model is appropriate and safe for their intended use case.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is Model Card — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
